questions.q: Which supplier is configured as LTV's preferred MRO supplier with EFT payment enabled?
options: Palmetto Steel & Alloy Supply
Vantage Electrical Components Inc.
Meridian Bearing Supply Co.
Crescent Freight Logistics
questions.explain: Meridian Bearing Supply Co. is LTV's preferred MRO supplier, configured with an EFT payment method and bank account on file.

questions.q: Under which business unit are all four of LTV's suppliers configured in this lesson?
options: Canada Operations BU
US Manufacturing & Distribution BU
Corporate Overhead BU
A shared, entity-neutral business unit
questions.explain: All four suppliers are configured under the US Manufacturing & Distribution BU, matching Chapter 2's Savannah-based purchasing activity.

questions.q: What does the 'preferred supplier' flag do?
options: It waives three-way matching requirements
It makes the supplier the default sourcing choice for matching item categories
It automatically pays the supplier's invoices without approval
It changes the supplier's payment currency
questions.explain: The preferred-supplier flag makes a supplier the natural default sourcing choice, which is why Meridian is selected for the bearing purchase order in a later lesson.

questions.q: Why must supplier setup happen before any purchasing activity?
options: Oracle Fusion requires suppliers to be created in alphabetical order
A requisition or purchase order cannot be created against a supplier that doesn't exist, and payment requires a valid method and bank account
Suppliers must be approved by the Canadian legal entity first
Purchasing only works if every supplier is flagged preferred
questions.explain: Purchasing transactions reference existing supplier records and payment details, so the master data has to exist first.

questions.q: What distinguishes the setup of Palmetto, Vantage, and Crescent from Meridian's setup?
options: They use a different chart of accounts
They follow the same basic pattern but are not flagged as preferred suppliers
They are configured under the Canada Operations BU instead
They have no payment terms configured at all
questions.explain: The other three suppliers use the same one-site, Net 30, three-way-matching pattern but without the preferred-supplier flag, since the capstone's walkthrough centers on Meridian.
